presence_rationale: Dedicated 'Cyber security, data protection and privacy' section with explicit commitments and scope across the bank's operations.
specificity_rationale: Names governance roles (CISO, Data Protection Officer, EDG team), specific frameworks (CPS 234, refreshed Privacy Policy), Data Event Management process, third-party assurance program, and Security Operations Centre. Multiple programmes named with controls and accountabilities.
quantification_rationale: Reports the SASB-mandated metric: 'three data breaches reported to OAIC under the Notifiable Data Breach Scheme'. Also reports 56% improvement in security behavioural index. However, no percentage of breaches that involved personal data and no number of customers affected, so the FN-CB-230a.1 disclosure is partial.
